children: Backpack Securities has issued $AMC on Solana in partnership with Sunrise. The token is redeemable 1:1 for AMC Entertainment shares and can be transferred to traditional brokerages, linking on-chain holdings with conventional equity custody.

The launch positions Backpack as a tokenized-equity issuer rather than only an exchange. Because $AMC is redeemable for the underlying share and portable to brokerages, it works as a regulated bridge between Solana and traditional equity markets, a structure that could extend to further tokenized stocks on the platform. For Backpack token holders the effect is indirect: any repricing of the platform's growth thesis around regulated tokenized equities flows through the business itself, not through the $AMC token.
